[EN] We need to clean up some of the trash the argons left behind.

Specifically, {@LinkCreature:47#4002#argonomorph naga wyrmlings}, {@LinkCreature:47#1002#argonomorph Tirkai grizzlies}, and {@LinkCreature:47#4003#argonomorph gula smashers} are making it hard to get from one place to another on the {@Rgn:47005$$Argon Frontier}.

Thin them out for us, will you?
[ES] Necesitamos limpiar algo de la basura que los argons dejaron atrás.

Específicamente, {@LinkCreature:47#4002#argonomorph naga wyrmlings}, {@LinkCreature:47#1002#argonomorph Tirkai grizzlies} y {@LinkCreature:47#4003#argonomorph gula smashers} están dificultando el desplazamiento de un lugar a otro en {@Rgn:47005$$Argon Frontier}.

Diezmarlos por nosotros, ¿quieres?

[EN] We appreciate it, .
[ES] Te lo agradecemos, .

[EN] I hope you haven't forgotten about hunting those {@LinkCreature:47#4002#argonomorph naga wyrmlings}, {@LinkCreature:47#1002#argonomorph Tirkai grizzlies}, and {@LinkCreature:47#4003#argonomorph gula smashers}. We need them gone.
[ES] Espero que no hayas olvidado cazar a esos {@LinkCreature:47#4002#argonomorph naga wyrmlings}, {@LinkCreature:47#1002#argonomorph Tirkai grizzlies} y {@LinkCreature:47#4003#argonomorph gula smashers}. Necesitamos que desaparezcan.
